Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism

package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism
SDK-owned Cubism snapshots, facade access, Preview services, and diagnostics.

Plugins use this package rather than Cubism host classes. Reads return immutable detached values. Editor-attached authoring writes are routed through transactions and versioned providers, and may fail closed when permission, support, generation, or provider admission is unavailable. This package does not claim that every host version implements every Preview facility.
